desc: Everything about this Beretta M9A3 air pistol screams range time! This officially licensed handgun from Umarex Airguns is a stunning replica of Beretta’s 9mm powder burner handgun; however, it is equipped with a special mode. With a simple flip of the switch on the right side of the hand guard this Beretta goes full-auto! Whether using the happy switch or doing handgun drills, you’ll enjoy the realism of the M9A3, right from its unique FDE coloring and authentic grip and feel, down to its realistic blowback action slide. Its full size magazine gives you the ability to practice reloads, and it holds a single 12 gram CO2 cartridge, along with 18 BBs
